ending: Zac's team destroys the Dead Zone fortress, kills the Lich King and the known female general, and dismantles the planet-conversion array. Zac binds the ghost custodian to lifelong service, removes the Seed of Undeath, completes Death Defiance, and brings his Draugr level even with his human level. The last zombies leave through the nexus before it vanishes, ending the immediate Undead Empire incursion. Kenzie, Ogras, Emily, and Joanna survive, but Zac needs time to recover from severe pathway damage. One undead general remains unaccounted for, and the custodian cannot reveal that general's plans. The Everlasting Dao leader and one companion escape their destroyed vessel. Alea's awareness within Love's Bond remains uncertain, Ogras still cannot evolve because of his shadow companion, and conflicting accounts leave Leandra's motives and Kenzie's significance unresolved. Zac also retains the contained creation and Oblivion remnants and receives bloodline marrow that he will not use until he understands his unusual inherited traits. Intelligence suggesting that a local faction may bargain with another incursion leaves Earth facing further danger.
in_short: Zac climbs the Tower of Eternity, strengthens his Dao, and survives both a Technocrat vessel and a public bounty at the exit. He steals a shard of creation, whose clash with his Oblivion splinter produces a System-bound cage that restrains both forces. Back on Earth, he ends an assault on Port Atwood, remakes the dying Alea as the spirit tool Love's Bond, and evolves into paired epic E-grade classes. After learning conflicting information about his mother Leandra, Zac leads Kenzie, Ogras, Emily, Joanna, and a Valkyrie squad into the Dead Zone. They breach the undead fortress, kill the Lich King, dismantle the conversion array, and remove the Seed of Undeath. The undead nexus disappears, but an Everlasting Dao leader escapes, Zac is badly injured, Alea's fate is unresolved, and new evidence points toward hidden bloodline history and possible dealings between a local faction and another incursion.

recaps.text: Previously: Zac leads Port Atwood and can cultivate through both living and Draugr forms, a dual nature he keeps concealed from most outsiders. Ogras is his demon partner and commander, while Kenzie, Alea, Thea Marshall, Billy, Emily, and the Valkyries form part of the force protecting his territory. Earth remains threatened by hostile incursions and by the Great Redeemer, a continuing enemy. Zac and Ogras have entered the Tower of Eternity seeking strength and a possible patron who can help shield Earth from that wider threat.

Zac and Ogras test Zac's new undead skills while advancing through the Tower, then separate so each can pursue his own climb. Zac learns True Strike from a guardian who first teaches and then tries to assassinate him, clears the fifth floor, and gains Cosmic Gaze. On the sixth floor he enters a Dao Discourse against three dryad siblings who covertly combine their power. Zac answers by unleashing his Axe and Coffin fragments together, winning access to the Pool of Tranquility. The pool strengthens his soul but also carries a hidden control seed. After resisting the intrusion, Zac exposes the dryad matriarch's scheme to enslave successful visitors as permanent guards. He cannot free the existing victims, but takes part of the pool's remaining power for his axe spirit before continuing upward.

Zac chooses the Nine Reincarnations Manual to strengthen his soul against the Oblivion splinter. The seventh floor places him in an undead kingdom fighting an insectoid hive, where his concealed Draugr form gives him unusual standing. He uses the campaign to train and defeats the breeder clone guarding the floor. News from Earth suggests Thea Marshall and Billy have advanced sharply during a dangerous battle. Zac also learns that Alea's poison constitution may be based on a hazardous method. A meeting with Boje Zethaya clarifies that Rasuliel Tsarun caused the earlier dispute over the Pathfinder Oracle's eye, opening a possible route toward renewed relations with the Zethaya Pill House.

A mentalist's soul attack nearly destroys Zac and frees the Oblivion splinter from its restraints. Zac survives by consuming the Prajna cherry reserved for Alea, and it transforms into an early Fragment of the Bodhi that repairs much of the damage. In the Battle of Fates, an immensely powerful flame cultivator tests Zac with a fire beam, claims they are linked by fate, and marks him before he breaks through her barrier and escapes through the teleporter. Zac then receives his seventh-floor rewards, including a limited-title slot and a choice among three major benefits, while the splinter remains a direct danger. Events on Earth reveal an Undead Empire operation led by an unnamed undead commander, whose forces are preparing a large-scale realignment and seeking a valuable body.

Zac advances through more Tower trials while searching for something capable of restraining the escaped Oblivion splinter. His route eventually brings him aboard a Technocrat vessel carrying a shard of creation. The ship's crew cannot safely control its effects, and Zac decides the shard may be his only chance to counter the force inside him. He infiltrates the vessel, learns that Technocrat advancement depends on integrated machinery and soul strength, and coerces a communications officer into guiding him. Leandra's necklace unexpectedly grants Zac high security access under an archaic authority code. After capturing the specialist responsible for containment, Zac abandons stealth and begins a direct push toward the shard chamber.

Zac reaches the creation shard but is overpowered by the vessel's D-grade captain. The shard enters Zac and proves as dangerous as Oblivion, turning stray desires into destructive changes while consuming his life force. Zac sabotages the ship and escapes into the next Tower level, where a dragon attacks as the two inner forces tear at their failing restraints. By forcing his life and death Dao powers together, he creates a chaos pattern that the System binds with golden fractals. The dragon dies, and the new cage holds the weakened creation and Oblivion remnants in mutual restraint. It also slowly purifies energy from them, though neither force is gone and the shard's emergency restorations have already cost Zac substantial vitality.

Zac chooses the Divine Investiture Array as his major Tower reward and reaches the ninth-floor threshold, where a Dao vision advances his Axe Fragment to middle grade. At the exit, the System offers other climbers ten Tower levels for killing the public figure Zac Piker within one minute. Hundreds attack. Galau supplies curse protection and tactical advice, while Ogras helps manage the defense. Zac breaks the attackers' coordinated arrays and kills their leader, a young Dravarak prince. Ogras ends the remaining pursuit, but the victory creates a new dynastic enemy. Zac then asks the gathered factions for help against the Great Redeemer. Potential supporters retreat when they learn that the enemy is connected to a powerful karmic clan.

A Draugr visitor trades Zac karmic defenses, warnings, and a Twilight Harbor token for information about her missing ancestor. Galau confirms that the Great Redeemer used mass sacrifice and other forbidden methods to restore his cultivation, while his clan connection makes open assistance to Earth hazardous. Boje Zethaya offers future access to tailored soul medicine but has no immediate cure for Alea. Zac then receives notice that Port Atwood is under attack and returns to Earth. He breaks the Everlasting Dao siege, redirects its sacrificial fire weapon into its own army, and kills the cultist bishop. At Arjrodim, he finds the undead defending a miasmic barrier and concludes that their objective lies behind it.

Zac reaches Alea's stasis site after undead agents have tried to convert her. Her body and soul are collapsing, but she communicates that she does not want to die. Rejecting a revenant transformation that would erase her identity or bind her to an undead ruler, Zac activates the Divine Investiture Array with her apparent consent. The process consumes rare materials and remakes her into a chained coffin spirit tool called Love's Bond. Its shield protects Zac, and a faint response suggests some connection remains, but Alea cannot communicate and her survival as a conscious person is not confirmed. Ogras returns and objects to the transformation, though he continues working with Zac as the surviving defenders assess the invasion.

Zac prepares to evolve without waiting for an impossible perfect foundation. He chooses separate epic paths for his two forms: Edge of Arcadia for life and Fetters of Desolation for death. The paired evolutions trigger two tribulations, which Zac survives to reach E-grade. During the process he experiences a family vision suggesting that Kenzie is tied to an ancestral purpose, although the vision's reliability is uncertain. His creation and Oblivion remnants remain confined in their chaos cage, and Love's Bond continues functioning as a spirit tool without proving whether Alea can ultimately return.

After evolving, Zac confirms that the nodes for his human and Draugr classes occupy the same locations in his body. He then investigates Leandra's necklace, and a synthetic intelligence modeled on Leandra appears from the pendant. It claims that Leandra recovered a dangerous former identity after Kenzie's birth, fled to protect the family, and left another protective intelligence with Kenzie. This account conflicts with Zac's evolution vision, which portrayed Leandra as pursuing an ancestral design centered on Kenzie. Zac accepts the warning to hide the family connection but does not treat the pendant intelligence as fully trustworthy. Leandra's location, her true objectives, and the nature of Kenzie's unseen protection remain unresolved.

Zac opens an inherited node called Void Heart, whose unusual ability helps process hostile energies. He decides to strike the Dead Zone before the undead realignment can finish. Emily insists on joining, and Joanna leads the Valkyries assigned to protect Emily and Kenzie. Ogras accompanies Zac, while Kenzie prepares specialized array breakers. After a dangerous teleportation attempt, the eleven-person party reaches an Underworld Council front-line base. Zac sees that death attunement is already altering the sky, and the System issues the limited quest Death Defiance to stop the process. He asks the Council to occupy a nearby undead force while his party targets its leader, then the team departs for the Dead Zone.

Emily's diversion and Kenzie's fire array breaker open a path through the Dead Zone's inner barrier. The team fights elite undead and arrays that can force living targets toward revenant conversion. Zac purges Ogras after one such strike, and the group reaches the Lich King's fortress. Kenzie's golden-eye breaker weakens the shield, her drones fire through the opening, and coordinated attacks from Zac and Ogras collapse the defenses. Zac enters, wounds the female general, and leaves Ogras to pursue her while he searches for the Lich King. The surface team remains behind to protect Kenzie and Emily as the fortress's surviving towers prepare a concentrated counterattack.

Love's Bond manifests an incomplete Alea-like avatar that absorbs the fortress towers' combined barrage, though it does not respond as Alea. Zac destroys the towers, finds the underground chamber, and confronts the real Lich King. A hidden spectral assassin wounds him, but his Draugr transformation turns the death array from a restraint into an advantage. Zac kills both assassin and Lich King, while Ogras kills the female general. Zac then forces open another node and suffers severe pathway damage. An Everlasting Dao vessel attacks the ruins. Zac destroys it and most of its crew, but the cult's leader escapes with one companion. The remaining zombies stop fighting and begin leaving Earth through the undead nexus before Zac collapses from his injuries.

Zac recovers and captures the Lich King's ghost custodian, who explains the conversion system but cannot freely disclose classified information. Kenzie safely dismantles the surrounding array while Zac contains its death energy. The custodian chooses a lifetime service contract with Zac rather than return to punishment. Zac then removes the Seed of Undeath, completes Death Defiance, and raises his Draugr level to match his human form. The final zombies pass through the nexus before it disappears, ending the immediate conversion threat. Zac's team survives, but he needs up to a week to heal his pathways. One undead general remains unaccounted for, and the custodian cannot disclose that general's plans. The Everlasting Dao leader remains free, Alea and Leandra remain unresolved, and intelligence suggests a local faction may be negotiating with another incursion. Zac also receives bloodline marrow and learns that many Earthlings may descend from escaped subjects of an ancient bloodline-research site, but he delays using it until he understands his own inherited traits.
